27 Years After Kargil Victory, Memories and What-Ifs Emerge

Twenty-seven years after India's victory in the Kargil War, emotional tributes are being paid. The sacred soil from the Kargil battlefield was handed over to the families of martyrs, leading to tears and embraces of memorial urns. One report also explored a hypothetical scenario, questioning how the war's narrative might have differed if a specific event involving a yak had not occurred.
